name: Annals of Internal Medicine — Ideas and Opinions
notes: Ideas and Opinions: a short essay for a general internal-medicine readership — no abstract, no keywords, no IMRaD sections. LIMITS: the word, reference and figure values are working values, not scraped from the published instructions for authors. Verify them against the journal's instructions before relying on them. Ethics approval, informed consent and trial registration belong on the ICMJE disclosure form, which Annals publishes alongside the article, not in the manuscript — an editor will ask for their removal. Every study named by acronym needs a one-line description in the text, and every effect estimate needs its 95% CI.
